messages:
maya: Quick usability pass on the dark console mock. Main flags: chart colors muddy at small sizes, code blocks sit too close to panel bg, and status chips lose pop against graphs. Screenshot: https://inbox.mock/screenshot :mag:
sam: Noted. The sparkline blue has low luminance contrast at 12px; legend dots disappear. Can we test desaturating the fill and brightening the line?
olivia: Love the new midnight tone but agree on spacing. Code block padding is 8px currently; feels cramped with wrapped examples. Bump to 12px? Also consider slightly rounded corners to match cards.
maya: Accessibility: battery of quick checks shows some chart series at ~2.9:1. We should aim for 4.5:1 for primary labels. Secondary series can be lower but still readable.
sam: Proposed vars: `--panel-900: #06101a`, `--panel-800: #0b1726`, `--code-bg: #0f2133`, `--accent-a: #5fd4ff`, `--accent-b: #a28aff`. I tested axis labels @13px and pass 4.5:1 with `--panel-800`.
design-bot: Filed issue: GH#789 - dark-theme contrast audit requested. Added initial token set `theme/dark-contrast-tune`.
harry: Copy nit: current toggle says "Theme: Dark" which reads like a mode label. Suggest icon-only toggle + accessible label "Theme: dark mode" and move explanatory text into settings: "Reduce motion / High contrast" options.
olivia: For charts: instead of linear gradient, try two-tone bands with subtle border stroke on area fills. Makes tiny areas pop without overpowering. Also try moving gradient midpoint to 30% as an experiment.
maya: Small UI nit: token usage chips are all same weight. Make 'current month' chip bold/outlined to retain hierarchy.
sam: I can prototype CSS vars and a tiny storybook entry. If we land on vars I'll run a visual diff.
design-bot: Created PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/436 (dark palette tweaks + storybook stories). CI: 1 visual snapshot diff flagged (chart midtones).
harry: Request adding an accessibility toggle "High contrast charts" under Settings -> Accessibility (off by default). Useful for demos and for folks in testing.
maya: Action list: sam to add story & PR; olivia to update spacing & copy; harry to add settings stub; maya to run full contrast report once PR lands. Aim: ship to staging tomorrow.
sam: Will push branch later today. :rocket:
